properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 10 at 5:37AM CDT until August 10 at 6:15AM CDT by NWS Kansas City/Pleasant Hill MO
properties.description:
At 536 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Spring Hill
and southeastern Johnson County, KS, and is nearly stationary.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Overland Park, Olathe, Leawood, Grandview, Belton, Raymore, Gardner,
Spring Hill, Peculiar, Bucyrus, Clare, Stanley, and Stilwell.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 35 in Kansas between mile markers 209 and 214.
Interstate 49 between mile markers 169 and 179.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 10 at 4:56AM CDT until August 10 at 11:00AM CDT by NWS Kansas City/Pleasant Hill MO
properties.description:
FFWEAX

The National Weather Service in Pleasant Hill has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southern Johnson County in east central Kansas...

* Until 1100 AM CDT Monday.

* At 456 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1.5 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1 to 2 inches in 1 hour.
Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1.5 inches are possible in
the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Overland Park, Olathe, Leawood, Gardner, Spring Hill, Clare,
Stanley and Stilwell.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.areaDesc: Grundy, IL; La Salle, IL; Livingston, IL
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 10 at 2:32AM CDT until August 10 at 7:00AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Livingston County in central Illinois...
East Central La Salle County in north central Illinois...
Southern Grundy County in northeastern Illinois...

* WHEN...Until 700 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Creeks and streams may rise out of their banks. Flooding
may occur in poor drainage and urban areas. Slow moving or standing
water may continue. High water likely may recede slowly from
flooded areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 228 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated that heavy rainfall had
moved out of the area. Rainfall amounts of 2 to 3 inches occurred
across the area, with rainfall in excess of 4 inches observed
near Dwight. Water will be slow to recede from fields, yards, and
poor drainage areas. Some streams may continue to rise due to
earlier rainfall as runoff moves downstream.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Ottawa, Streator, Dwight, Gardner, Mazon, Grand Ridge, South
Wilmington, Ransom, Verona, Campus, East Brooklyn and Kinsman.
- This includes the headwaters of the Mazon River, Otter Creek, and
Covel Creek.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
A Flood Warning means flooding is imminent or may already be
occurring. Persons along rivers, creeks, and other waterways should
take immediate precautions to protect life and property.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 10 at 6:39AM EDT until August 10 at 8:15AM EDT by NWS Cleveland OH
properties.description:
SMWCLE

The National Weather Service in Cleveland has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Nearshore waters from Maumee Bay OH to the Islands OH...
Open waters from Maumee Bay OH to The Islands OH...

* Until 815 AM EDT.

* At 639 AM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from Bolles Harbor Of Refuge to 14 nm southwest of North
Cape to 26 nm south of Luna Pier, moving east at 40 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Reno Beach, Put-In-Bay, and Kelleys Island.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.
